README.md.title: FRC Programming Lessons & Interactive Labs | Team 1257
README.md.description: Learn FRC robot programming with Team 1257. Free Java and WPILib lessons, interactive PID and swerve demos, and real competition robot code.

java/README.md.title: Java Programming for FRC
java/README.md.description: Learn Java for FIRST Robotics Competition: variables, control flow, methods, classes and objects, with exercises for new robot programmers.

frc/README.md.title: FRC Robot Programming with Java and WPILib
frc/README.md.description: Build command-based FRC robot software with Java and WPILib. Learn subsystems, sensors, PID, autonomous routines, simulation and logging.

labs/README.md.title: Interactive FRC Programming Labs
labs/README.md.description: Experiment with PID, swerve, motion profiles, commands, odometry and robot mechanisms. Step through visual models beside real robot code.

robot-types/README.md.title: How to Program Different FRC Robot Mechanisms
robot-types/README.md.description: Program shooters, turrets, elevators, arms, intakes, drivetrains and climbers with interactive demos and source-backed FRC robot examples.

robots/README.md.title: Team 1257 Robot Code and Log Walkthroughs
robots/README.md.description: Trace real Team 1257 robot code and inspect a recorded competition robot log. Connect command-based architecture to practical FRC examples.

guides/start-here.md.title: Start Learning FRC Robot Programming
guides/start-here.md.description: New to FRC programming? Set up your tools, choose a Java or robot programming path, and run your first small project with Team 1257.

git/README.md.title: Git and GitHub for FRC Teams
git/README.md.description: Learn version control for your FRC team: repositories, commits, branches and collaboration with Git and GitHub.

vision/README.md.title: Robot Vision for FRC
vision/README.md.description: Explore FRC robot vision with PhotonVision, Limelight and WPILibPi, including camera setup and practical vision programming lessons.

foundations/README.md.title: FRC Robot Foundations
foundations/README.md.description: Understand how an FRC robot works: power distribution, signals, motors, sensors, mechanisms and the software that coordinates them.

labs/pid.html.title: PID and Feedforward Interactive Lab
labs/pid.html.description: Tune PID gains and feedforward in a visual teaching model. Compare tracking error, saturation, windup and gravity compensation one step at a time.

labs/swerve.html.title: Swerve Drive Kinematics Interactive Lab
labs/swerve.html.description: Explore swerve drive translation, rotation, field-relative control, wheel speed limits and steering optimization with live module vectors.

labs/scheduler.html.title: Command-Based Scheduler Interactive Lab
labs/scheduler.html.description: Step through WPILib-style command scheduling. Explore subsystem requirements, command interruption, release behavior and default commands.

labs/encoder.html.title: Encoder Units and Homing Interactive Lab
labs/encoder.html.description: Convert encoder turns to mechanism distance. Experiment with gearing, units, home-switch polarity and position references in an interactive model.

labs/motion.html.title: Motion Profile Interactive Lab
labs/motion.html.description: Compare triangular and trapezoidal motion profiles. Change distance, acceleration and velocity limits and inspect the reference trajectory.

labs/odometry.html.title: Odometry and Delayed Vision Interactive Lab
labs/odometry.html.description: Explore odometry drift and a simplified timestamped vision correction. Compare pose estimates and inspect the effect of delayed measurements.

labs/log.html.title: FRC Robot Log Explorer
labs/log.html.description: Inspect an excerpt from a real Team 1257 robot recording. Compare voltage, velocity and enabled signals while tracking their separate timestamps.

frc/1-Basics/README.md.title: FRC Robot Programming Basics
frc/1-Basics/README.md.description: Set up your FRC programming environment and learn robot subsystems, command-based architecture, motors, simulation and your first WPILib project.

java/3-Functions/1-Basics.md.title: Java Methods and Functions
java/3-Functions/1-Basics.md.description: Learn how Java methods organize reusable code, then practice defining and calling functions for clear, maintainable robot programs.

website/README.md.title: Maintain the Team 1257 Website
website/README.md.description: Learn the layout and maintenance workflow for Team 1257’s website, including annual updates and practical editing tasks.

java/1-Basics/2-Variables.md.title: Java Variables and Types
java/1-Basics/2-Variables.md.description: Learn to declare and use Java variables. Explore primitive types, strings, assignments and casts with concrete examples and practice.

java/1-Basics/programs/Variables.md.title: Java Variables Practice Program
java/1-Basics/programs/Variables.md.description: Practice Java variables in a small programming exercise. Apply declarations, assignments and types after reading the variables lesson.

java/1-Basics/programs/README.md.title: Java Basics Practice Programs
java/1-Basics/programs/README.md.description: Practice Java fundamentals with small programs on variables, input and arrays, and connect the exercises to the matching lessons.

java/2-Control_Flow/programs/README.md.title: Java Control Flow Practice Programs
java/2-Control_Flow/programs/README.md.description: Practice Java conditions and loops with control-flow programming exercises and links to the related lessons.

java/3-Functions/programs/README.md.title: Java Functions Practice Programs
java/3-Functions/programs/README.md.description: Practice breaking a Java program into reusable methods with function exercises and links to the related lessons.

java/4-Objects/programs/README.md.title: Java Objects Practice Programs
java/4-Objects/programs/README.md.description: Practice Java classes and objects through small programming tasks and apply the ideas from the object-oriented lessons.
